channel.title: Violations Watch: Lebanon
channel.description: New incidents reported in Lebanon. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Israeli artillery shelling and strikes reported across southern Lebanon on 22–23 Nov; two people injured by an explosive remnant of war
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). South Lebanon. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces. Reported casualties: 2 injured. Disputed or caveats: Syrian state media (SANA), Iranian state media and an X post; not independently verified. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1879

item.title: Israeli airstrikes, shelling and building demolitions reported across southern Lebanon on 19-20 Nov, including Qantara, Shaara, Haddatha, Kfar Tebnit, Kounine and Zawtar al-Sharqiya
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Lebanon. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces.
